method: Latin-hypercube Monte Carlo (50 runs) of JutulDarcy 2D waterflood over permeability median, sigma, correlation length, Corey exponents, connate water and residual oil; one new field realisation per run
notes: Ranges are illustrative priors chosen for the spike, not calibrated to any field or dataset. Teapot Dome is not used (data not downloaded, license unresolved). Material-balance check validates reported/integrated volumes (injected - produced = change in water in place at the report steps), not the solver's internal conservation. Median permeability has little effect on recovery because injection is rate-controlled in pore volumes: the same pore volumes go in whatever the permeability, which mainly changes pressure. P90 = low case, P10 = high case. Percentiles use runs that passed checks.

case_labels.note: P90 is exceeded by 90 % of runs. For recovery factor P10 = high case (best); for water cut P10 = high water cut = worst case.
